verdict.rationale: Jules supports browser-based takeover clearly: users get notified when a task needs input, can send messages to redirect the agent mid-session, and review/approve diffs and plans in the web app (jules-docs-4, jules-docs-6, jules-docs-7, jules-docs-12). GitHub issue-based tasking also allows redirection via comments. However, there is no first-party evidence of editor or terminal-based takeover — only a community member building a custom MCP server to dispatch tasks from VS Code (jules-comm-19), which is unofficial. Missing for 10: official editor/IDE integration for redirecting in-progress tasks, a terminal/CLI interface, and independent confirmation that mid-task redirection works reliably.
